Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICSIL Assistant Programmer Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the ICSIL recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the ICSIL recruitment is Assistant Programmer. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Programmer post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Assistant Programmer post in this ICSIL recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this ICSIL recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this ICSIL recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview in person.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Programmer position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Assistant Programmer position will receive a salary of Rs. 24356 Per Month.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Assistant Programmer post?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a Master's Degree in Computer Applications/Information Technology/ Computer Science or a B.E/B.Tech in Computer Engineering/Science/Technology from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Assistant Programmer post is scheduled for 31 August 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the ICSIL office in New Delhi. The exact address is 110002.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the ICSIL Assistant Programmer recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves Document Verification followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the application fee for the ICSIL Assistant Programmer recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 590 for General/OBC and Rs. 590 for SC/ST categories.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry original documents and self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and category certificates if applicable.
